responsibility: Implements pattern-specific lowering support used by statements, parameters, and match-like control flow. It builds CASE_LABEL_EXPR trees for literal, range, wildcard, and enum-variant patterns; extracts bindings from struct and tuple-struct patterns by projecting fields out of the scrutinee representation; and lowers let-pattern initialization by destructuring tuples and assigning or materializing temporaries, while issuing unsupported-pattern diagnostics for forms not yet handled in backend lowering.
same_name_distinction: Provides the concrete implementations of the pattern helpers declared in rust-compile-pattern.h. Unlike the header, it contains the actual lowering code for case-label construction, enum/struct scrutinee field extraction, pattern-binding registration, and let-pattern destructuring.
